test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

If you are going to keep eating those cookies, you are going to ____ your dinner.
solution:
The correct answer is '**miss**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**miss**" means to fail to take advantage of something or to be too late for something.
 
• In this context, eating cookies would mean that you might not have room for dinner, thus you might miss it.
 
• The other options: "**mute**," "**allow**," and "**cheer**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *If you are going to keep eating those cookies, you are going to miss__ your dinner.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mute**: means to make silent or quiet.
 
• **Allow**: means to permit.
 
• **Cheer**: means to shout for joy or in support.
